title: Andrija Puharich, the Ossining 'space kids' and the Council of Nine

tellings.quote: he's the the father of kind of a lot of CIA mind control stuff in MK Ultra but he's bumping into non-human intelligences and having these quote unquote space kids in Austining New York channel

plain: Andrija Puharich, whom Michels calls the father of much of the CIA's mind-control work in MK Ultra, a secret CIA programme that tested ways of controlling the mind, also kept running into non-human intelligences. Michels says Puharich had a group of "space kids" in Ossining, New York, channel, meaning receive messages from, beings called the Council of Nine, sometime between the 1950s and the 1970s. Michels tells it from what the researcher Greg Malatzi has said and from a book called The Mind Traveler, and also mentions a man named Dan Sherman. If true, the same man was building the CIA's mind-control work and talking with beings that are not human.
